about_the_game:
Eclipse of Eldergaard is a dark fantasy, time-bound action-adventure where every second counts. You are thrown into a cursed world teetering on the edge of destruction, tasked with a single, desperate mission: close the four hell gates before Umbra, the fallen Wukong of Shadow, returns to consume the overworld.

The Legend of Light and Shadow

Long ago, the divine chose two legendary brothers:

  • Solion, the Wukong of Light, destined to protect the overworld.

  • Umbra, the Wukong of Shadow, bound to rule the underworld.

But greed devoured Umbra’s heart. He denied the divine order, opening the gates of hell to unleash his wrath upon mankind. Cities burned, skies bled crimson, and hope nearly perished. To end the slaughter, Solion battled his brother in an earth-shattering duel. Neither could win, until Solion forged a desperate solution, a crystal seal that bound Umbra into eternal imprisonment.

With his final breath, Umbra cursed the world:
“Every 33 years, on the Bloody Day, my legions will rise again… and my prison will weaken.”

Your Role: Ren Huo, Disciple of Light

You are Ren Huo, the youngest and weakest disciple chosen by Solion’s legacy. Unlike the First Disciple, whose strength rivaled legends, you are untested, fragile, yet burdened with destiny.

On this Bloody Day, the seal weakens. Hell gates crack open across Eldergaard known as Crimson Valley, spewing demons. The First Disciple of Solion watches you from the shadows, mocking your every step, testing whether you deserve the mantle of Light.

The world does not need another legend.
It needs someone willing to bleed against time itself.

Race Against Time

The seal weakens every moment you linger.
Your mission: close all three hell gates before the crystal prison shatters.

  • Fail to seal the gates → Umbra escapes. He will strike you down in two blows, one dodged by fate, the second ending your journey.

  • Succeed in sealing them → Umbra remains trapped, and light returns to Eldergaard.

Every playthrough is a test of endurance, timing, and decision-making. The clock never stops.

Power of the Crystals

Scattered across the land:

  • Crystal Shards → used to heal and stabilize Umbra’s weakening seal.

  • Four Sacred Crystals → awaken your hidden potential, unlocking your full disciple powers.

Without them, you are vulnerable. With them, you may stand a chance when the final strikes.

The Presence of the First Disciple

Throughout your journey, you are watched.
The First Disciple of Light, the strongest warrior Solion ever trained, appears not to aid you, but to taunt you. His words cut as deep as the claws of Umbra’s demons, reminding you of your weakness.

But why does he watch?
Is it judgment, or preparation for something darker?

Key Features

  • Intense Time-Limited Gameplay – every second matters as the seal decays.

  • Hell Gate Encounters – face swarms of demons, each gate summons danger.

  • Crystal Progression System – collect shards to heal the seal and sacred crystals to unlock your true disciple form.

  • Dynamic Combat – dodge, strike, and survive as waves of enemies test your skill.

  • Two Possible Endings – fail and witness Umbra’s freedom… succeed and secure Eldergaard’s fragile hope.

  • Atmospheric World – one overworld map, one task-based mode, both filled with dread, fire, and the crimson skies of the Bloody Day.

The Question of Hope

Eclipse of Eldergaard is not a story of triumph. It is a story of survival, sacrifice, and inevitability.
Solion vanished into myth. Umbra waits for his chains to break.

Now, the burden falls on you.
Will you rise against the Bloody Day, or become just another shadow in the eclipse?


Estimated playtime: ~1 hour.

content_descriptors.notes: Eclipse of Eldergaard contains themes of violence and dark fantasy. Players will encounter combat with weapons, blood effects, and hostile creatures. The game features a bleak post-apocalyptic world with disturbing imagery such as corrupted environments and monstrous designs. While the game includes mature themes, it does not depict sexual assault, non-consensual sex, or extreme real-world abuse. Players sensitive to violence, gore, or dark psychological themes may want to take caution.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 380 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space (SSD strongly recommended) GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times.
